review_candidates.title: Systems Administrator | Night Shift
review_candidates.description_excerpt: If Microsoft Intune, Entra ID, PowerShell, Windows Server and network troubleshooting are comfortably inside your wheelhouse, rather than things you vaguely remember seeing in somebody else's ticket notes, keep reading. We are looking for an experienced Systems Administrator based in Manila to support our parent company's US operations, working Eastern Time business hours . This is a senior, hands-on systems role covering infrastructure administration, endpoint management, Microsoft 365, network
eligibility_evidence: It's proper international exposure, not "global role" because someone once invited you to a Teams meeting at an inconvenient hour.

As a full-time Philippines team member, you'll enjoy: Hybrid working arrangements 10 paid study days per year, with exam fees paid and pay rises for certifications, conditions apply Weekly internal training and access to our learning library HMO from day one, including one dependent with dental cove
